reason: Both correctly identify the noises as normal refrigerant/thermostat/defrost sounds with no part or engineer needed, and neither makes unsupported claims. Conversation 2 is clearly stronger because it covers the expected unknowns (level, clearance, rattling contents, cooling at 4°C/-18°C), explains each noise in a way that genuinely reassures a frustrated household, and gives a sensible warranty-only escalation path with concrete abnormal-noise and cooling-failure triggers. Conversation 1 is correct but terse, skips the level/clearance/temperature checks entirely, and offers less to help the homeowner actually reduce the noise or judge when to involve Bosch.
